The '''Battle of Mandalore''' took place during the final days of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. During the battle, [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Atoko]] released a [[nanovirus]] onto the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], targeting the [[Clan Fett|Fett genome]].

==Prelude==
During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] sided with the [[Jedi Coalition]] that opposed the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance government]]. In [[41 ABY]], the Mandalorians defended the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roche asteroid field|Roche]] during the first Galactic Alliance [[Battle of Roche|assault]] on the world, and they later took part in the attack on the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] during the [[Second Battle of Roche]]. In retaliation, Galactic Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Atoko]] was tasked with neutralizing the threat that the Mandalorians posed.<ref name="in" />

==The battle==
With the remnants of the [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet]], Atoko led the attack on the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Atoko released into Mandalore's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] a [[nanovirus]] that had been developed during the Second Battle of Roche. The nanovirus targeted the [[Clan Fett|Fett genome]], with the intended result that the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and members of his family could never again set foot on the world.<ref name="in" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Mandalore was first mentioned in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]'', the ninth and final novel in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series, written by [[Troy Denning]] and released on [[May 13]], [[2008]].
